CONTENT REQUIREMENTS”
● Minimum Length: 12 seconds, Max: 60 Seconds | Sync drops to visual peaks
● Always use provided audio links | Hook in the first two seconds.
● Language: English
● Audience: Tier 1 (majority) + Tier 2 + Tier 3
● Engagement Rate: Minimum 1% (at least 10 likes per 1,000 views)
● Likes & Comments: Must stay ON at all times
● Optional Hashtags: #TheWeeknd #fayewong
● Optional Caption: The Weeknd - Hong Kong Performance
● Posting: You can post multiple clips per platform
RULES
● No story boosting, no dedicated accounts
● No NSFW, sexual, aggressive, weird, mean, or rude content toward any person
● No spamming the same clip across multiple accounts
● No collab posts
● Max Payout 20% of Budget
ANALYTICS & APPROVAL
Once your video reaches 1,000 views, send a screen recording of your analytics to support showing your
watch times, all view graphs, and locations. All pages must be clearly visible. Video-specific analytics
only — account analytics will be rejected.
Only submit if your engagement is above 1% AND your audience tier meets the requirement, or your
submission will be rejected.
Questions? Reach out in the support chat!
